parent before committing the self-release lifecycle transition. That one parent
publication witness now consumes the existing ReadCanonicalEventRecord owner,
returning immutable complete persisted event evidence with explicit absence.
The exact derived event ID and selected run must both match. Missing, unreadable,

Canonical decoding strengthens the former row-count-only evidence. The transition

The complete callback inverse preserves early delegation, selected-grant identity,
explicit/subject/missing lineage, commit, pending-operation matching, both missing
parent retries and every event/outbox conservation assertion.
